title: End Minus Start
kicker: Under the Pond · Floor One, Part 1
blurb: Floor one. A lift that takes a change, and a track of three spans. A change is end minus start, and slope is the same idea done twice: change in height over change in posts. Uphill, flat and downhill. Somebody else is down here, moving the floor.
note: Captions stay on. Pause twice: after Marcus says "Plus six!" at the lift, ask what is about to go wrong; and after "Is it broken?" on the flat span, ask whether a slope of zero is broken. Level means the lift only: on the track the graph reads posts and height.
